title: Return values from blocks and functions
summary: Use a function’s tail expression, an explicit early return and a local block value. Keep integer units and reference results explicit.

unsigned.clue: Unsigned 32-bit parameter type for a nonnegative minute count

arrow.clue: Syntax separating a function’s parameter list from its return type

condition.clue: Keyword introducing a branch when value exceeds limit

early.clue: Keyword exiting capped immediately with limit

fraction.clue: 64-bit floating-point type used for fractional division

unit.clue: Unit type representing the absence of a meaningful value

equal.clue: Macro comparing seconds to the expected converted duration
